data.long_description:
Provident Estate is pleased to offer you this Stunning Two Bedrooms Apartment for Sale at Grand Bleu Tower, Elie Saab at Emaar Beach Front, Dubai Harbour.

Property Features :

⦁ 2 Bedrooms
⦁ 3 Bathrooms
⦁ 1,715 Sq. Ft.
⦁ Low floor
⦁ Sea View
⦁ Fully Furnished
⦁ Vacant Now
⦁ Allocated parking
⦁ Shared Gym and Pool

Project Features :

Grand Bleu is a luxury residential tower in Emaar Beachfront offering elegantly designed apartments with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai’s skyline. Residents enjoy premium amenities including a swimming pool, gym, landscaped leisure areas, and direct beach access. 

About the Community :

Dubai Harbour is a premium waterfront community offering luxury residences, a marina, and direct beach access in a prime coastal location. It features high-end towers, promenades, and leisure spaces with stunning sea and skyline views. With easy access to Dubai Marina and Sheikh Zayed Road, it’s ideal for users seeking an exclusive seaside lifestyle close to the city.

Proximity :

It’s only 10 minutes drive to The Dubai Marina Mall and 25 Minutes to Burj Khalifa, and 30 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB) so you don’t have to worry as you are close to all the Dubai iconic destinations!

Get in touch now for more info and to arrange a viewing!
